args.title: Ironbark Tooling newsletter summary — Freight pricing this quarter
args.body:
- Newsletter: Ironbark Tooling's latest newsletter covers "Freight pricing this quarter," linking to a blog article and a companion piece tailored to the reader's company.
- Article (blog.ironbark.example/2026/freight): Spot freight rates fell 9% this quarter while contract rates held steady, and fuel surcharges now track weekly diesel prices.
- Companion piece (insights.ironbark.example/freight/companion): Shippers who split volume across three carriers paid the least.
